cases.description: Verify calculation adds two positive integers correctly
cases.command: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from calc import add; assert add(2, 3) == 5"

rubric.summary: Calculator add function must add positive integers correctly
rubric.requested_correction: Implement add(a, b) in src/calc.py to return a + b.

cases.description: Verify calculation multiplies two positive integers correctly
cases.command: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from calc import multiply; assert multiply(3, 4) == 12"

rubric.summary: Calculator multiply function must multiply positive integers correctly
rubric.requested_correction: Implement multiply(a, b) in src/calc.py to return a * b.
